title: STEP 13J - Final security audit
scan_scope: All tracked and untracked project files (source, docs, configs, tests, frontend, Docker). Scanned for: api keys, tokens, passwords, secrets, credentials, bearer tokens, private URLs, .env files, hardcoded secrets.

false_positive_matches.detail: os.environ["db_pwd"] - env-var reference, not a literal
conn string built from config objects / env

notes: No hardcoded secrets, API keys, tokens, credentials, or .env files were found anywhere in the project (api/, src/, frontend/, configs/, tests/, docs/, scripts/, Dockerfile, compose).

The only regex matches were inside dataset/electric-vehicle-uds-dataset-main/ (TUM third-party repo). All are os.environ["db_pwd"] environment-variable references that READ from runtime env - no literal secrets are present.
The TUM dataset directory is already git-ignored (dataset/electric-vehicle-uds-dataset-main/) and will NOT be published to GitHub.
api/main.py explicitly states no secrets are needed: "Configuration (environment-driven, no secrets)".
Remediation: none required. For GitHub publication, ensure .gitignore rules remain in place and no .env file is ever created.
